contexte_state.about: Posts published on X (Twitter) by French news outlets, journalists and activist accounts on two Saturdays in France.
contexte_state.mobilisation_days: On Saturday 17 October 2026 and Saturday 24 October 2026, nationwide street protests took place across France against the cost of living, led by high-school students, students, unions and Gilets jaunes. The 17 October day saw riots, looting and fires (Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Limoges). On 24 October many cities banned protests; the Paris march went from Porte d'Italie.
contexte_state.other_events_same_days: Same weekend, unrelated to the mobilisation: on 23 October a racist terrorist shooting in Trappes and La Verriere (suspect Kevin T.); on 24 October the Rassemblement national (RN) party congress in Orleans, with a separate counter-protest against the RN in Orleans.

instructions.question: Does `post` report something that happened in the streets during the nationwide protest day: marches, crowds, blockades, police charges or tear gas, injuries, arrests, looting or damage linked to the protests?
instructions.counts: a march or crowd figure; police using tear gas on protesters; a shop looted on the margins of the protests; a protester injured by a grenade; a town hall set on fire after the march
instructions.does_not_count: the Orleans counter-protest against the RN congress; the Trappes shooting; a politician's statement with no description of events

criteria.true: the post describes events in the streets linked to the protest day
criteria.false: the post is about something else, such as politics in general, sport, culture or another news story

instructions.question: Does `post` report a statement, decision or reaction by a politician, official, police union or commentator about the nationwide protest day?
instructions.counts: the interior minister giving an arrest count; a mayor condemning the looting; Melenchon praising the marches; a court lifting a protest ban; the government asking telecom operators to prepare to cut social networks
instructions.does_not_count: reactions to the Trappes shooting; statements at the RN congress about the RN itself

criteria.true: a reaction or decision about the protest day is reported
criteria.false: no reaction about the protest day, for example a reaction to another event

orleans_rn.instructions: Is `post` about the Rassemblement national congress in Orleans or the counter-protest against it?

criteria.true: the RN congress or the Orleans anti-RN protest is the subject
criteria.false: the post is about another place or event

trappes.instructions: Is `post` about the racist shooting in Trappes and La Verriere, its victims, suspect or aftermath?

criteria.true: the Trappes shooting is the subject
criteria.false: the post is about another event

autopromo.instructions: Is `post` the account talking about itself: asking to turn on notifications, announcing a new or backup account, its own suspension, a buyout offer, or asking followers to send videos?

criteria.true: the account promotes or talks about itself
criteria.false: the post reports news about the world

violence_policiere.instructions: Does `post` show or report police force used against protesters: charges, batons, tear gas, grenades, injuries caused by the police?

criteria.true: police force against protesters is reported
criteria.false: no police force against protesters is reported, for example a peaceful march or looting

pillage_degats.instructions: Does `post` report looting, vandalism, fires or attacks on buildings or on the police by people at the protests?

criteria.true: looting, damage or attacks by protesters or rioters are reported
criteria.false: no such damage is reported, for example a calm march or a police charge

ton.instructions: How does `post` present the protest movement?

criteria.favorable: sympathetic to the protesters: celebrates turnout, denounces repression, relays their demands
criteria.hostile: unfavourable to the protesters: stresses chaos, rioters, looting or the far left as the main story
criteria.neutre: factual reporting with no clear sympathy or hostility

table_de_decision.post_manif: (rue >= 0.7 OU reaction >= 0.7) ET trappes < 0.3 ET autopromo < 0.3 ET (orleans_rn < 0.3 OU INCLURE_ORLEANS)
table_de_decision.post_autre: rue < 0.3 ET reaction < 0.3, OU trappes >= 0.7, OU autopromo >= 0.7
table_de_decision.INCLURE_ORLEANS: faux : posts sur le congres du RN a Orleans et la contre-manifestation classes autre
